_comment: Instafill.ai. A brand is only these tokens -- copy this file, change the four colours and the two font paths, and every template draws that company's card instead. The mint is the same #13BA82 the lower-third accent uses, so a card, a label and a badge on one film read as one channel.
_note: radius_px 0 is deliberate: hard rectangles give the wipe a clean edge to travel along. Round them for a softer card, but check the wipe again -- a large radius makes the reveal look ragged.
